name: Drei
role: Helper components for React Three Fiber: controls, loaders, text, environments
summary: Large collection of ready-made React Three Fiber components and hooks: Environment lighting, Text, Html, loaders, camera rigs, controls, ContactShadows, Float and more. Driven by JSX inside an R3F Canvas; output is the same Three.js scene. Distinguishing strength: removes boilerplate for common scene furniture, though interactive helpers matter little in offline capture.
use_when: Over hand-written Three.js setup when R3F is the shell and you want Environment, Text or Bounds
Quick studio lighting and contact shadows for product shots
Billboard and SDF text in a 3D scene without wiring troika yourself
avoid_when: No React in the project: Three.js with its examples/jsm helpers
Interaction controls: useless in frame capture, skip them
Minimal bundle: Three.js directly, importing only what is needed

assessment.rationale: pmndrs repo with regular releases through 2026; MIT. Only meaningful alongside React Three Fiber, so its value follows that decision.
